item.title: My wife cried when I found out she had only $80,000 in her 401(k). I have $2.2 million. Am I wrong to be shocked?
item.description: “When I brought up retiring last spring, she said she was ready whenever I was, and I took that to mean we were in good shape.”
item.dc:creator: Quentin Fottrell
